To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
space charge in polypropylene depends on copolymerizaiton, electrode, temperature etc.
the space charge distribution in polypropylene (PP) and its copolymers depends on the copolymerization.
the copolymerization of PP with ethylene has a great effect on the DC current and space charging characteristics.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of copolymeric structure on space charge in polypropylene.
the effect of the copolymerization with ethylene and the catalyst on the DC conduction current and the space charges in the copolymer.
the effects of copoly-merization on space charge distribution in polypropylene.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effects of copolymeric structure on space charge formation and distribution are complex and dependent on the type and amount of ethylene, the type of catalyst and other factors.
space charge in PP and copolymers depends on the electrode, the temperature, the copolymerization and so on.
the copolymerization has a significant effect on the DC current and space charges in PP and PP based materials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the space charge in PP copolymered depends on the copolymerization and the space charge in M-PP is larger than that in H-PP.
the space charge in PP copolymerable is affected by the copolymerization and the electrode.
the space charge in PP and its copolymers can be controlled by copolymerization and the copolymerization method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
space charge in PP and its copolymers can be controlled by copolymerization.

the copolymerized polypropylene (PP) with Ziegler-Natta catalyst has the similar morphology to that of the homopolymer, but the copolymer with metallocene-catalyzed has the different morphology from that of homopolymer.
copolymers of PP with 3.0 wt% of ethene, prepared using a Ziegler catalyst have the same morphology and the same space charge characteristics as the homopolymer.
